title: Fideon canonical schema - wc (policy_check)
description: SPEC_21 section 4 canonical schema for wc, workers compensation and employers liability (code WC), composing common_model.json 1.1.0 by $ref: the envelope plus locations, rating_exposures (the Item 4 classification schedule), rating_modifiers (experience, schedule and merit rating) and countersignature, and one LOB-local block (wc: the Item 3.A states, the Item 3.C other-states wording and the rating-bureau identifiers). Built from the labels the line's real workers compensation documents print (the 39 digital documents of the source-data wc folder, 3 carrier folders with digital documents, read in place), every field of the pre-SPEC_21 wc.json 1.6.0 (wc.crosswalk.yaml) and the line's L1 registry YAMLs. Seed golds are DRAFT, not signed off.
fideon:status: SPEC_21 schema built from the wc seed documents and the legacy wc.json 1.6.0; 2.0.0 (10 October 2026) replaces the self-contained 1.6.0 file (fideon.canonical.workers_compensation) with a composition of common model 1.1.0. Draft for the project owner's approval; the wc seed golds are drafted against it (DRAFT, pending reviewer sign-off). Change requests: CHANGE_REQUESTS_wc.md. 2.1.0 (23 October 2026) is additive: two additions to the wc block (total_estimated_cost, officers[]) and printed-name aliases from the recurring wording of the V3 originals; nothing removed or renamed (CHANGE_REQUESTS_wc.md CR-WC-08 to CR-WC-10). 2.2.0 (26 October 2026, additive): coverage-code names and codes for the coverage rows printed by the G1 scanned and hybrid seed documents (change request approved by the project owner). No path, code or alias is removed or renamed.

corpora: synth_core/fideon/synth_core/data/source data/<Carrier>/wc/ (40 documents of 4 carrier folders: AmTrust 7, Hartford 24, NYSIF 8, Berkshire Hathaway GUARD 1 scanned, not read)
fideon:built_from.v3_recurring_wording: POLICIES-FINAL-V3 wc folder (83 distinct documents), read in place for RECURRING FORM WORDING only: a caption counts when it prints in at least 5 different documents of at least 3 different carriers; counts only, no document text or value kept (decision 115, 23 October 2026)

fideon:lob_block: wc: concepts only the workers compensation Information Page prints and no common block covers (SPEC_21 4.2.4): the states Part One applies to (Item 3.A), the Part Three other-states wording (Item 3.C), the NCCI carrier code and the rating-bureau file number (risk id). Part One, Part Two (employers liability, with its three limits) and Part Three are coverages (wc.coverage_codes.yaml); the classification schedule is rating_exposures and the experience, schedule and merit rating factors are rating_modifiers. 2.1.0 adds total_estimated_cost (the premium plus surcharges total that premium.total does not hold) and officers[] (the officers and owners schedule).
fideon:audit_rules_note: Rules 1-5 are common_model.json fideon:default_audit_rules (SPEC21_TEAM_PROMPT 7.3; the claims-made rule is not evaluable on a workers compensation policy, which prints no retroactive date, and is kept so the LOB file carries the defaults unchanged). Rule 6: Part Two's bodily injury by disease each-employee limit never exceeds the disease policy limit (NCCI WC 00 00 00 C, Part Two D). Rule 5 (a warn) means AT LEAST ONE coverage has a limit: Part One (statutory) and Part Three print no limit; Part Two prints three. The mandatory field is coverages[].coverage_name, a coverage row with or without an amount (M2.9 fix 4, 19 October 2026): the New York State Insurance Fund's Information Page prints no Part Two limits, only the Workers Compensation and Employers Liability policy it attaches to.

wc.part_one_states: Part one of the policy applies to the Workers Compensation Law of the states listed here

WorkersCompensationTerms.description: LOB-local block (SPEC_21 4.2.4): what only a workers compensation Information Page prints and no common block covers.

part_one_states.description: Item 3.A: the states whose workers compensation law Part One applies to, one entry per state as printed.
fideon:aliases: Part one of the policy applies to the Workers Compensation Law of the states listed here

other_states_insurance.description: Item 3.C: the states Part Three (other states insurance) applies to, as printed (usually one sentence: 'All states except ...').

ncci_company_number.description: The carrier's NCCI company (carrier) code printed on the Information Page.

bureau_file_number.description: The insured's rating-bureau file number (risk id) that links its experience rating; Interstate/Intrastate Identification Number on NCCI forms.

total_estimated_cost.description: The total estimated cost of the policy as printed: the total estimated annual premium plus the state assessment and the other surcharges ('Total Estimated Cost', 'Total Estimated Policy Cost'). premium.total stays the premium before the surcharges.

officers.description: Item 6 / officers and owners schedule: the corporate officers, partners, members or sole proprietors the policy names and whether each is included in or excluded from coverage, one entry per person as printed ('Name of Officer(s)').

title.description: Officer title or ownership role (President, Secretary, Member, Partner, Sole Proprietor).

included.description: Whether the person is included in or excluded from workers compensation coverage.

class_code.description: The classification code the person's remuneration is rated under.

remuneration.description: The remuneration (payroll) attributed to the person, as printed.

wc.description: Workers compensation terms no common block covers (LOB block).
